overall: The AG found the two Board-created teams were not public bodies under the Open Meeting Law because they lacked empowerment to act collectively, so no violation occurred; no orders issued.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board created two subcommittees at an April 2 meeting with no agenda, public meeting, or minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Because the teams fail the second prong of the public body analysis, we find that they were not public bodies subject to the Open Meeting Law.
